subject.title: Oakland Unified School District Board, District 2

photo.credit: Printed in Alameda County's Voter Information Guide

text: I, ARIELLE FLEISHER, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: School Director District 2
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Policy Development and Research Manager
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): None

5. Statement of General Qualifications: I’m an OUSD parent and policy leader running for school board. I founded a moms community now 300 strong, serve on my school’s PTA, and lead my neighborhood council. For over a decade, I’ve tackled Bay Area policy challenges: launching vaccine clinics, improving transit, and advancing safer streets. When OUSD faced a budget crisis, I didn’t wait for a title. I attended board meetings, published budget explainers, and became a trusted voice on district finances. OUSD spends more per student than any large district in CA, yet only 1 in 3 students reads at grade level. We regained local control last year and it’s already at risk. This moment demands experienced policy leadership. As your school board member, I will bring honest budgeting, transparency, and an unwavering focus on student outcomes. Our kids get one education. Let’s get it right. Vote Arielle Fleisher for Oakland School Board, District 2.

text: I, JENNIFER BROUHARD, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: School Director District 2
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Retired Educator and teacher
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): School Board Director District 2

5. Statement of General Qualifications: As an award-winning OUSD retired teacher with 27 years of classroom experience, a parent and current Board President, I have dedicated 38 years to serving Oakland’s students, families, and schools. Over the past four years, my work centered on fiscal responsibility, student achievement, and supporting educators who make learning possible. Every decision centers students. Every neighborhood deserves high-quality public schools that meet students’ needs. Maintaining safe, stable schools, retaining excellent educators through competitive compensation ensures our most vulnerable students receive necessary support to succeed. As Board President, I continue to lead the district through financial challenges to produce a balanced budget protecting classrooms and preserving local control. Responsible budgeting and educational excellence go hand in hand. My experience as a retired Oakland educator guides every decision I make. I respectfully ask for your vote to continue building safe, stable, equitable schools where every OUSD student thrives.
